About Us

In 2006, Ronald Giraldo ventured into the wallcovering industry with a strong desire to leave a lasting impression. Fueled by unwavering passion and a commitment to creating remarkable spaces, Ronald began his journey. RG Wallcovering swiftly gained recognition for dedication to quality and innovative design installations, positioning itself as a leader in delivering expert installation services for comprehensive wall solutions of all types.

Pushing the boundaries of possibility, the team reinforced its commitment by seeking knowledge through training and earning certifications. This dedication solidified our aim to provide top-notch installation services across a wide range of comprehensive wall solutions. Through dedication and an unwavering pursuit of excellence, RG Wallcovering gained recognition as trusted experts within the design industry, specializing in providing comprehensive wall solutions through expert installation services.

As RG Wallcovering continues to evolve, they are poised to redefine the boundaries of what is possible in delivering expert installation services for comprehensive wall solutions. Passion for exceptional wall finishes, coupled with growing expertise in interior design, sets the stage for a new chapter of creativity, innovation, and breathtaking transformations in the realm of installation services for all types of wall solutions.

 

Our mission

At RG Wallcovering, we believe that our clients deserve nothing but the best. That’s why our team consists of not only skilled wallpaper professionals, painters, and interior designers but also individuals who genuinely care about creating beautiful spaces. What sets us apart is the personal touch we bring to every project. Led by industry-recognized experts, our team combines years of experience with a deep understanding of our clients’ needs and desires. We’ve cultivated strong relationships with major industry companies, constantly seeking advice and staying up-to-date with the latest materials and trends.

With us, you can trust that your project is in the hands of a dedicated and knowledgeable team. Our passion for art and atention to detail is the driving force behind everything we do. We approach each project with meticulous care, creating designs that are exclusive and tailored to your unique vision. We treat our clients like family, ensuring a seamless and enjoyable experience from start to finish.


When you choose RG Wallcovering, you’re not just hiring a company—you’re joining our family. Let us bring warmth, creativity, and a personal touch to your residential project or commercial space. Discover the RG Wallcovering difference and embark on a journey of transformation with people who genuinely care.

We turn your walls into Works of art

How we do it?

RG Wallcovering understands the client’s needs in order to materialize their dreams into reality. We plan and calculate our work and execute it according to schedule. We perceive ourselves as artists who transform raw materials into true works of art, where both the final result and the process are important, therefore, we are impeccable with the cleanliness of our work space and we always take care of the details. Our accompaniment is a quality experience from start to finish.

What Makes Us Different?

We love challenges that allow us to propose innovative solutions. We use the latest technology in wallcoverings and our team keeps up-to-date with new trends, techniques, tools and materials. We enjoy our work and we do it with good disposition. Our team is proactive.
